svg.title: Feature rank association with absolute error
svg.desc: Heatmap of Spearman correlations between the eight existing features and absolute error for thin-line and arc-stroke scopes, including severity strata.
svg.text: Feature rank association with absolute error
Spearman rho within condition/severity strata; exploratory and not source-clustered inferential tests.
Larger positive values mean higher feature values accompany larger absolute error. Severity and source composition remain confounded; no feature is selected.
